usdRate.note: AUD 1 = USD 0.7031, so about AUD 1.42 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 1.552. Nauru uses the Australian dollar.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Nauru Bureau of Statistics, CPI March 2025 quarter
inflation_cpi.note: CPI up 4.4% in the year to March 2025 (latest release, published June 2026). The 2026-27 Budget (IMF WEO April 2026) gives period-average inflation of 6.1% for 2024-25 and 5.5% for 2025-26.

inflation_projection.sourceName: 2026-27 Budget Paper 1 (IMF WEO April 2026): CPI 4.2% for 2026-27; IMF WEO path to 2.5% by 2030
inflation_projection.note: Nauru imports almost everything and uses the Australian dollar, so inflation should settle toward Australia's 2-3% band plus import-cost shocks; 3.5% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics (Reserve Bank of Australia cash rate target)
policy_rate.note: Nauru has no central bank and uses the Australian dollar; the RBA cash rate (raised to 4.60% on 29 September 2026) is the policy rate for its currency.

savings_account_rate.note: The only bank presence is a CommBank agency (since August 2025) offering basic and online saver accounts; no Nauru-specific interest rate is published.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No term deposits are listed for Nauru customers at the CommBank agency, the only bank on the island.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No term deposits are listed for Nauru customers at the CommBank agency, the only bank on the island.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product exists in Nauru.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No deposit rate statistics are published for Nauru (no central bank; World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no Nauru data).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Nauru issues no government savings certificates or retail bonds.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Nauru issues no treasury bills; government debt is external loans only (2026-27 Budget Paper 1).

tbond_5y_rate.note: Nauru issues no domestic government bonds.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Nauru issues no domestic government bonds.

tax_bank_interest.note: Nauru Revenue Office pages cover Employment and Services Tax and Business Tax; no rule on individuals' bank interest was found.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists in Nauru.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No Nauru deposit insurance scheme was found; whether Australia's Financial Claims Scheme covers deposits taken through the CommBank Nauru agency is not stated on its page.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card products or rate cap for Nauru were found; the CommBank agency lists only debit cards.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock market; global equity in AUD terms. CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund held from Nauru in Australian dollars after a weak decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No local stock market; global equity in AUD terms. CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
equity_return_base.note: No local exchange exists, so base equity is a global index in AUD, held to the safe rate (about 0.5%) plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No local stock market; global equity in AUD terms. CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
equity_return_high.note: High case near the long-run return of global shares in Australian dollars.

gold_return_low.sourceName: AUD/USD 0.703 (30 Oct 2026); World Bank AUD per USD 1.55 in 2025
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stronger Australian dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: AUD/USD 0.703 (30 Oct 2026); World Bank AUD per USD 1.55 in 2025
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus little expected AUD depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: AUD/USD 0.703 (30 Oct 2026); World Bank AUD per USD 1.55 in 2025
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker Australian dollar.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: cash held in a basic account earning nothing.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a saver account at a low rate; no term deposits or government paper are sold locally.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: online saver with bonus interest, if available to Nauru customers.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No insurance regulator or published life insurance claims data exists for Nauru.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No local term life insurance market was found in Nauru.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public health care is free for citizens at the Republic of Nauru Hospital, with referral to Australia; no private hospital cost data exists.

health_premium_table.note: No private health insurance market was found in Nauru.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending is 0.73% of current health expenditure; care is free for citizens.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Nauru Bureau of Statistics CPI (4.4% to March 2025); free public health care
goal_inflation_health.note: Care is free for citizens, so health costs to plan for move with general prices; the headline projection is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Nauru Bureau of Statistics CPI (4.4% to March 2025)
goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index is published; the headline projection is used.

life_table_remaining.note: UN WPP life tables are not published on the secondary sites read for Nauru (populationpyramid.net has no Nauru page) and WHO GHO does not cover it.

support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio 5.03 (2025). No 2040 or 2065 projection was found on the sources read.

retirement_age_default.note: The Nauru Superannuation Scheme page does not state a withdrawal or retirement age, and no statutory retirement age was found.

retirement_age_government.note: No public service retirement age for Nauru was found on the Ministry of Finance site.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate

retirement_return_base.sourceName: CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at what a basic saver account is likely to pay; no term deposits or government paper exist locally.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
retirement_return_high.note: High case: online saver with bonus interest.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: No local market; balanced global mix in AUD. CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of global shares and cash.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: No local market; balanced global mix in AUD. CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half global shares at 4.5% and half cash at 0.5-1%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: No local market; balanced global mix in AUD. CommBank Nauru agency offers only basic and online saver accounts (no term deposits); no published rate
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning global mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Government of Naoero, 2026-27 Budget Speech (revised aged pension rates)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Aged pension AUD 400 at 60-69, 500 at 70-74 and 600 at 75+ (from the 2025 Truuk Memorial revision). The speech does not give the period; the Social Welfare Division page lists the earlier rates (250/300) as fortnightly, so 400 a fortnight = about 867 a month.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Nauru Ministry of Finance, Social Welfare Division (Aged Pension)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Residents over 60, living in Nauru; not means tested, but people with another regular income such as a job are not eligible. Higher rates from 70 and 75.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service benefit for private employees was found for Nauru.

public_pension_scheme.note: The Nauru Superannuation Scheme (employer 10% from 1 February 2026, employee 5%) is a provident fund; its withdrawal age and payout rules are not stated on the Ministry of Finance page.

savings_account.note: Offered through the bank agency that opened in August 2025.

fdr_3m.note: No term deposits are offered to Nauru customers.

fdr_1y.note: No term deposits are offered to Nauru customers.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificates or retail bonds.

tbill_91d.note: The government issues no domestic securities.

equity_fund.note: No local stock exchange or locally sold funds; residents would have to invest abroad.

gold.note: No local gold bullion dealer was found; no legal restriction is known.

centralBank.name: Reserve Bank of Australia (Nauru uses the Australian dollar and has no central bank)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Aged Pension, Social Welfare Division (Ministry of Finance)
